purpose: Technique-exploration journey assertions; not passing evidence or a replacement for frozen backend evaluations.
preservation: Use the existing signed-in Dev account
Capture original recipe hashes before actions
Undo and verify every saved recipe change
Do not reset authentication or domain history

cases.precondition: Jar #1 has a supported standard V60 hot recipe
turns: What's an interesting different V60 technique to try with Jar #1?
Show me the first one again
assertions: First response includes exactly one named persisted card without a second request
Second card has a distinct eligible family
Comparison creates no new proposal
First-again selection identifies the original proposal and does not reactivate its stale action ID

cases.precondition: A coffee has a Kalita 155 recipe; the same slot must not imply a 185 base
turns: Show me a different Kalita 155 technique for this coffee
assertions: 155 card carries exact size and source revision
Correction retires 155 focus
Missing 185 base gets the existing generation entry, never implicit replacement
A compatible 185 base yields only 185-eligible choices

cases.precondition: A coffee has the supported ribbed Switch 03 hot recipe
turns: Show me a different Switch technique
Can I try full immersion instead?
assertions: Hybrid and immersion are genuinely distinct families
Every valve cue keeps its source timing anchor
Native volume units remain visible
Over-capacity dose is rejected with a usable supported-dose suggestion

cases.precondition: An actionable source-backed card exists and its original saved recipe hash is captured
actions: Change dose within the source-supported range
Ask to save this trial permanently
assertions: View does not start a timer or create a trial
Technique identity and all quantities survive dose change
Server snapshot, displayed recipe and timer agree
Later save targets the actual trial snapshot
Undo restores the original saved recipe hash

cases.precondition: Reference-only or unsupported configuration is requested
turns: Show me an iced Switch recipe
What about the two-temperature Devil recipe?
assertions: Useful reference explanation does not create an executable card
No invented timing, temperature or hardware transfer
Domain limitations are not reported as AI connectivity failure

cases.precondition: Available families and saved-family identity are known
actions: Request alternatives until eligible families are exhausted
Start New chat and request a technique
assertions: Successfully delivered families are excluded, not failed attempts
Exhaustion offers revisit, comparison or references without calling a repeat new
Retry does not consume another family
New chat resets conversational exclusions but preserves saved recipe history

cases.precondition: A proposal is being prepared or an explicit action is in flight
actions: Retry through the existing recovery control
assertions: No duplicate proposal or mutation from response loss
Cancelled preparation adds no late card
Existing useful prose and cards survive errors
Restored timer does not replay completed valve actions
Signed-in account remains intact

cases.precondition: TE01 and TE04 are rendered with a 320px viewport, enlarged text and reduced motion
actions: Receive the card while scrolled to latest
Receive a response while reading older content
Open and close recipe details with keyboard visible
assertions: Card and View recipe are reachable above the composer
Reading position is preserved
Return focus goes to originating card
Touch controls remain at least 44px
Reduced motion is respected
